title: Sales per night and Moon's acrobatics
summary: Moon sold about a hundred bottles a night and performed trapeze and a leopard skin act.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How many bottles would he sell in an average night?
Sometimes one person would buy maybe five bottles.

He would average a hundred bottles a night, which in those days was a lot. A lot of times we'd steal the bottles ourselves and sell them on extra... What happened, you see, when we... You'd do your show. You'd go through all your routines and everything. I'd do my little
act. I would play "Margie," and then maybe sing a chorus, and then dance a chorus, and then the next guy would do something, and then he'd make another spiel.
Another thing, he was an acrobat.

He did things on...like you see in a circus, like a trapeze, and these rings these guys perform on... He had them on portable poles and things that held up. He'd strip off his clothes there, and then he'd put on a half a leopard skin. "This is an animal, a leopard I had to... I don't like to execute and kill animals, but he tried to... I killed him with my bare hands. That's what Moon Tonic will do for you."
It was unbelievable! And people would... But he was a very muscular guy. But still he was almost a midget; he was about five feet tall.
